data.title: Akamai’s Transformational Anthropic CIS Deal Boosts Long-Term Outlook but Near-Term Cash-Flow Pressures Keep William Power at Hold, Price Target Unchanged at $140
data.description:
Analyst William Power from Robert W. Baird maintained a Hold rating on Akamai and keeping the price target at $140.00.

William Power has given his Hold rating due to a combination of factors tied to Akamai’s transformational CIS agreement with Anthropic. The seven-year, $11.6b CPU-focused deal, with potential expansion to roughly $20b, significantly enhances Akamai’s long-term revenue profile and positions CIS to become its largest business line by 2028, with strong strategic importance versus peers.

At the same time, the deal requires approximately $5.5b of capex, driving notable free-cash-flow pressure, reducing interest income, and potentially necessitating capital markets funding, all of which weigh on near- to mid-term earnings. Questions around return on invested capital, dilution from Anthropic warrants, and the timing of revenue ramp versus peak capex lead Power to keep a Neutral stance, with the price target unchanged at $140.
